title: Associate Product Security Eng
description:
### **What you will do**


* Minimum of 2\-6 years of experience in Cyber security in Operational Technology domain.
* Strong understanding of network security and system security principles.
* Proficiency in security tools and technologies (BurpSuite, Qualys, Metasploit, Cloud, IOT and embedded devices)
* Proficiency in SDLC, security management and engineering expertise, Threat modelling, Application Security, Network Security, Mobile Security, Software Security etc.
* Experience with severity ratings systems, and ability to calculate CVSS ratings for identified vulnerabilities.
* Knowledge of penetration testing techniques, application security vulnerabilities, OWASP Top 10, SANS 25, CWE, etc.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Relevant certifications such as CEH, GPEN, Licensed Penetration tester are highly desirable.
* Conduct regular security audits and assessments on multiple projects
* Prepare and present security reports to management and regulatory bodies
* Mentor and support junior security staff
* Promote a culture of security awareness throughout the organization.
* Stay updated with the latest cyber security trends, threats, and technologies.
* Recommend and implement improvements to enhance the organization's security posture.
* This position is for the **Engineer – Cyber Security** role within the **ETC Product Security team**, based in **Bangalore**. It follows a **hybrid work schedule**, with onsite work required **four days a week, from Monday through Thursday**.


**What you will bring:**


* We will need to backfill this replacement as the Cybersecurity team is working on quite a few enterprise wide initiatives


We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.
